  <div class="main-content-container" style="z-index:5;position:relative;"><p style="tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font voluntarily deferred or contributed by the Participant pursuant to all qualified or nonqualified plans of any Employer and shall be calculated to include amounts not otherwise included in the Participant&#x2019;s gross income under Code Sections 125, 132, 402(e)(3), 402(h), or 403(b) pursuant to plans or arrangements established by any Employer; provided, however, that all such amounts will be included in Base Salary only to the extent that had there been no such plan, the amount would have been payable in</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font absence if the period of such leave does not exceed six months, or if longer, so long as the individual retains a right to reemployment with the service recipient under an applicable statute or by contract.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font which the STI Award shall be determined (or such earlier date as specified by the Administrator).</font></div></div><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font designated Distribution Subaccounts.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font prescribed by the Administrator for that purpose.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">to changes in Deemed Investment Elections, which may include limiting the percentage, amount and frequency of such changes and specifying the effective date for any such changes.</font></p><p the resulting amount by the closing price of one share of the Company&#x2019;s common stock on such Dividend Payment Date.</font></p><p beginning after the year of the Triggering Event, and (b) if the Form of Payment is installments, such installments shall begin in the year following the Triggering Event or in any of the first two (2) years beginning after the year following the Triggering Event.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">the day to day administration of the Plan.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Administrator may appoint other persons or entities to perform certain of its functions.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Such appointment shall be made and accepted by the appointee in writing and shall be effective upon the written approval of the Company.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Administrator and any such appointee may employ advisors and other persons necessary or convenient to help him/her carry out his/her duties.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">The Administrator shall have the right to remove any such appointee from his/her position.</font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;"> </font><font style="color:#000000;white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;font-kerning:none;min-width:fit-content;">Any person, group of persons or entity may serve in more than one capacity.</font></p><p style="text-indent:6.667%;tab-size:26.66px;font-size:12pt;margin-top:12pt;font-family:Times New Roman;margin-bottom:0;text-align:left;"><font the Change in Control.</font></p></div>
